description: This Java source file defines the class 'ChangeOperation', which models various types of changes (like charges, transactions, or term variations) associated with loan accounts in the Fineract project. It includes methods for determining the type of change, calculating effective dates, and comparing change operations for ordering.

classes.name: ChangeOperation
classes.description: Models a change operation in a loan account, which can be a charge, transaction, or term variation, with logic for comparison and property checks.

methods.name: ChangeOperation
methods.description: Constructors for wrapping different types of change data (charge, transaction, or term variations).

methods.name: isLoanTermVariationsData
methods.description: Checks if the change is a loan term variations data.

methods.name: isTransaction
methods.description: Checks if the change is a loan transaction.

methods.name: isCharge
methods.description: Checks if the change is a loan charge.

methods.name: isInstallmentFee
methods.description: Checks if the charge is an installment fee.

methods.name: getEffectiveDate
methods.description: Calculates the effective date of the change based on its type, considering backdated charges, installment fees, and transaction dates.

methods.name: getSubmittedOnDate
methods.description: Retrieves the date on which the change was submitted or became applicable.

methods.name: getCreatedDateTime
methods.description: Retrieves the creation timestamp of the change.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares two ChangeOperation instances for ordering based on effective date, disbursement priority, accrual status, submitted date, and creation date.
